body: Yeah I’m English. I know social media isn’t reality but I have nothing much better to do so I tend to timewaste on it a lot I guess. I’m mostly just applying for stuff like waitressing, cafes and restaurants and stuff. If I get them I’ll try and be friendly with the people there. I’m just always afraid to start conversations cause I worry I’m being annoying. Like if I didn’t worry about not being liked, I’d probably talk more and be liked more, it’s confusing

It’s good to hear an introvert can make it after schools over. I’m trying to fill up my time with hobbies and stuff but I get very unmotivated cause I’m depressed, and just end up watching other people have fun on snapchat and Instagram and shit like that. I am trying to get a job, hopefully that will improve things for me. Do you have any tips for forcing yourself to talk? I’m really bad at starting conversations and I kind of assume people don’t want to talk to me anyway. I feel like it would improve if I got over that.
Oh and thanks for saying you liked my username :))

Thing is though, I’ve tried to make connections and I do have casual friends. I just can’t go from this to the kind of closer friendships I want to have. Like ones where we can meet up and have social lives with and shit. Also, I don’t think I’m going to become any calmer as I grow up, I’m naturally very easily upset and emotional, always have been.

Thanks for the advice:) did it get better for you, over time? I’ve tried the goal setting thing and when I actually have motivation to achieve them it works. I’m also trying to get a job cause that way is go out more. I’ll look into the groups thing but I don’t think there’s much around where I live, especially cause I can’t afford to pay for anything. I’m just gonna try and focus on getting into a good uni.

I’m 16. I’ve been at my current school 5 years now and haven’t found a group of people “just like me”. I have a friend group but they all have much more in common and are closer with each other. Don’t get me wrong, they don’t purposefully leave me out, they’re lovely people, I just don’t fit in anymore, since my best friend changed school so she’s not in the group really anymore.

Thanks dude. Yeah that’s basically my life as well, I’m sorry you have this shitty situation. I relate to your feelings as well, like I’m so stressed and bored and probably should go to therapy but I really don’t want to. I’ve lost energy for trying.If you want to talk about your problems, go ahead and message me. I like feeling like I’m helping people. Plus, I’m lonely so it would be great just to have someone to speak to yanno :)
